nq_scaling_checkpoint.clock_contract: Fresh processes, unchanged public harness and tolerances. Fit includes compilation, optimization and finalization.
nq_scaling_checkpoint.thread_contract: Dense BLAS 8 / Numba 1; discrete BLAS 1 / Numba 16. SUPERGLM_BLAS_THREADS independently overrides the solver cap. OMP_WAIT_POLICY and GOMP_SPINCOUNT are explicitly unset in defaults; only the separate PASSIVE arm sets OMP_WAIT_POLICY=PASSIVE, before imports.

passive_control.decision: One sample uses less CPU but takes longer; no latency improvement demonstrated.

q222_witness.dispatch_scope: Timed receipts resolve dense/chunked policy and observe thread pools, without kernel instrumentation. Only this untimed witness directly observes batched native calls; empty panel observations do not establish panel dispatch.

guards.memory_policy: Before each worker, host MemAvailable and memory available under inherited finite cgroup limits must cover twice the estimated peak plus 4 GiB. All observed fit highwaters, including witness, fit their estimates. No finite inherited cgroup limit was found.
guards.activity_policy: Ten-second external CPU preflight and endpoint audit; no flagged contention. These guards do not prove absence of all transient activity.

nq_scaling_checkpoint.raw_hash_manifest: manifest.json stores every worker report, ten-array NPZ, capture, capture-start, log and activity-audit hash; all were rechecked after completion.
caveats: Eight single grid fits, one separate control and one untimed witness; no medians, confirmations, significance or universal scaling law. Optimization work changes across N and q; paired routes have matched coefficient/smoothing iterations but likelihood counts differ.
Dense/discrete differences describe the accepted 256-bin approximation, not roundoff certification or exact equality. Terminal-score relative differences are sensitive to small reference norms.
Fit RSS is process highwater and can include preceding allocations; later output highwater is separately reported. Conservative planning estimates are not certified memory bounds.
Default arms explicitly clear GOMP_SPINCOUNT. Earlier campaigns inherited unspecified wait/spin environment; cross-window differences cannot be assigned to source changes or wait policy.
Dense settings reuse the previous fair tuning; this grid does not retune every N/q cell.

ordinary_blas_discriminator.small_oracle: 12 tests passed in 2.96 seconds: independent signed/cancellation geometry oracle and scope/restoration/method-drift guards.

One pair and fixed order do not establish significance or universal BLAS policy. No complete-fit improvement or 12.5-second result follows.

category_support_discriminator.decision: This single pair supplies no evidence of latency improvement; category placement is deferred for the current target, not proven inferior universally.

category_support_discriminator.numerical_scope: Large geometry uses descriptive relative differences and gamma_(N+q)*reference-norm scales only, not cancellation-safe certification. Independent small oracle uses dimension/epsilon/absolute-product bounds and a mutation witness.
caveats: One geometry sample per arm in fixed order; no statistical or universal ranking follows. No complete-fit or 12.5-second latency result is established.
